title: 2027 Disclosure & Democratic Enquiry Calendar
scope: Constituent-led disclosure, records recovery, administrative review and democratic engagement across the wider Llandough-juxta-Penarth / Leckwith research.
principles: Zero cash expenditure. Any fee, paid copy, subscription, paywall, postage, licence, travel or court cost triggers PAUSE—NO SPEND; use a free lawful alternative or close the avenue.
Maximum two outbound messages across all institutions and all routes on any calendar day. This is a hard ceiling, not a target.
No new outbound contacts 1–15 January 2027. Use the first two weeks to reconcile live 2026 clocks, replies, attachments, drafts and requester closures.
No blanket first-week FOI. Tier 1 and Tier 2 contacts are staggered and conditional on complete 2026 thread checks.
Use FOI/EIR only where the recipient is subject to the relevant regime; SAR only for personal data; voluntary records/archive enquiry for private recipients.

Internal reviews, reconsiderations, regulator complaints, ombudsmen and elected-representative routes are conditional on eligibility and each institution's published process. Nothing is sent automatically.
Court, tribunal, judicial review, pre-action, litigation and fee-bearing routes are excluded. This is constituent engagement through democratic and administrative channels.
Request text, review grounds and complaint submissions are intentionally populated during 2027 from source evidence, not invented in this calendar.

requester_closures.meaning: Requester initiated, not an institutional non-response or missed deadline.

roadmap.scope_note: Lane-level roadmap message count; not mailbox-wide totals.

2026_baseline.caution: Different source cut-offs and denominators are retained separately and must not be added together. Refresh the 2026 year-end sources before any 2027 send.

forecast.follow_up: Each first-contact slot has response, chaser decision, internal-review eligibility and remedy eligibility checkpoints. These are not automatic emails or fixed legal deadlines; recompute dates against the actual route and reply.
forecast.end_state: Not every remedy or institutional avenue can responsibly be forecast as exhausted by 31 December 2027. Some regulator and ombudsman processes may carry into 2028; G4 records the evidence-based disposition and reason.
forecast.capacity: 50 slots, not 50 guaranteed requests. Existing live 2026 processes, duplicates, cost barriers, irrelevant routes and missing QA remove or defer slots.
